🇺🇸🇮🇷 Trump is being pulled between peace and war with Iran, and one more strike could change everything

With rumors of a potential diplomatic breakthrough emerging from Qatar, Drop Site News founder Ryan Grim joined me to discuss the extraordinary power struggle unfolding around Trump's next move.

On one side, JD Vance and the diplomatic camp are pushing for a deal that could finally end the war.

On the other, military planners are preparing options ranging from limited strikes to ground operations, while Netanyahu continues pushing for renewed war.

But Ryan raised a disturbing possibility: what if the biggest danger isn't one massive attack, but a series of smaller escalations that gradually make peace impossible?

He described how presenting Trump with increasingly aggressive military options could make each smaller strike seem reasonable, even as the conflict moves closer to catastrophe.

And the economic consequences could be devastating.

Ryan warned that another major escalation could inflict lasting damage on energy infrastructure, potentially keeping oil prices around $100 a barrel for years, even if a ceasefire eventually follows.

Meanwhile, he believes Israel's once-formidable political influence in Washington is facing an unprecedented challenge following the Republican midterm defeat.

The question is whether Trump recognises that political reality before another military escalation closes the door on diplomacy.

So... it happened.

The first 7-figure acquisition on TrustMRR.

$1,000,000 exactly. Sold in October.

It’s a GTM startup that was just over a year old. The founders listed it on TrustMRR 9 months ago, when I launched the marketplace.

They received a dozen offers. They picked one, and it took more than 6 months to complete the process, including due diligence.

I can’t describe how happy (and proud) I am to have built TrustMRR.

It started as a vibe-coded leaderboard, and it’s now a real startup marketplace.

- 215 acquisitions this year
- 23 days on average from listing to acquisition
- 8,131 verified buyers
- 84 offers/inquiries per day

I’m spending more time working TrustMRR because I think it’s one of my most AI-resilient businesses (network effect).

My goal for 2027 is to make acquisitions 10x faster. Escrow accounts for 70–80% of the time from listing to acquisition, and it doesn’t support some currencies/countries, causing about 30% of transactions to fall through.

Godspeed 🫡
